feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day weather forecast

items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 18 November 2026 4:15pm
items.description:
##Today##

There will be clear intervals and only isolated showers for the remainder of the day and early tonight. Mainly light southwesterly winds will back to become mainly moderate easterly overnight. Under clear skies, temperatures will briefly dip inland to 4°C.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 4°C and max. air temperature 11°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

5-10


##Wind Speed##

10


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

Southwest or variable 5-10 or less before strengthening from the east tonight.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain. Occasional hill fog.


##Comments##

Nil.


##Tomorrow##

Cloud thickening again around midnight, bringing a scattering of showers through the rest of the night. Mainly moderate easterly winds and a minimum midnight to dawn temperature of 6°C. Generally cloudy with only isolated showers tomorrow daytime, then becoming dry later. Moderate to fresh easterly winds, increasing strong in exposed places at first, with temperatures up to 9°C. Comments: Strong wind at first.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 5°C and max. air temperature 9°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

1-5


##Wind Speed##

16


##Wind Direction##

E


##Wind##

Easterly 10-15, but 20-25 in more exposed places during the morning.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain. Occasional hill fog patches until later.


##Comments##

Nil.


##Friday, 20 November 2026##

A chilly start to the day with minimum of around 2°C, but otherwise dry and mainly sunny during the daytime, a moderate northeast breeze falling light, and temperatures up to 9°C. Comments: Risk of frost in sheltered places.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 2°C and max. air temperature 9°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

0


##Wind Speed##

17


##Wind Direction##

NE


##Wind##

Easterly 15-20, becoming northeast 10-15.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Comments##

Nil.


##Saturday, 21 November 2026##

Another chilly start to the day with a risk of frost in places, then sunny spells, turning cloudier through the afternoon. Light easterly winds will gradually strengthen, becoming a strong southeasterly by the evening. Top temperature 8°C. Comments: Risk of a frost in places. Strong winds later.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 3°C and max. air temperature 8°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

0


##Wind Speed##

20


##Wind Direction##

SE


##Wind##

Northeast 10-15, gradually veering and increasing east or southeast 30-35.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Comments##

Nil.


##Sunday, 22 November 2026##

Turning cloudy with a risk of rain developing for the afternoon. Strong southeast winds will gradually ease, with temperatures up to 9°C. Comments: Strong winds. Risk of coastal overtopping around high tide.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 6°C and max. air temperature 9°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

3-10


##Wind Speed##

23


##Wind Direction##

SE


##Wind##

Easterly 30-35, gradually easing southeast 15-20.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain. Hill fog increasing.


##Comments##

Nil.
